correctness.rationale: With exact conditional representation (X,Y)=S(U,V), the standard covariance identity reduces sign to q(t)-rho(r). Both base moments are integrated over their exact trapezoidal domains; the taper density is exactly proportional to s². The derivative q_prime is negative on 0<t<1; the aspect cubic has one positive root, and rho_prime is negative. This proves all interval endpoints, uniqueness, and the sqrt2 asymptotic. verify.py independently integrates 96 3D convex-hull triangulations with rational tetrahedral moments and checks symbolic formulas.

value.rationale: Canonical lattice/geometry coordinates of a named rational-linear-precision prismatoid family yield an exact sharp two-parameter sign phase diagram. The crossing occurs within a constant face lattice and persists for actual integer-parameter family members at two rational tapers. The sharp aspect cubic, unique moving taper threshold and sqrt(r) scaling at large aspect identify a nontrivial natural geometric boundary between opposing intra-slice and scale-mixture covariance mechanisms, useful for understanding inertia of tapered polytopes.
